title: Subwavelength exceptional points in dispersive resonator arrays
summary: Exceptional points provide a mechanism for producing strong spectral sensitivity in non-Hermitian wave systems. For subwavelength resonators with highly dispersive material parameters, however, the resonance problem is not a linear eigenvalue problem in the frequency. In this paper, we use the Lippmann-Schwinger formulation and the associated volume-potential reduction to study exceptional points in dispersive resonator arrays.
